scenario.name: base
scenario.label: Base: trim half at +50%, hold rest, RSI(m) 90 exit, replace >100% winners

scenario.name: no_trim
scenario.label: No trim: hold until RSI(m) 90 exit or replaced

scenario.name: rotate
scenario.label: Rotate: hold exactly the current top 10 each quarter

scenario.name: rsi80
scenario.label: Base with the monthly-RSI exit at 80 instead of 90

scenario.name: eps_dn30
scenario.label: Base + sell at a month-end when point-in-time TTM EPS is 30% below its level at entry

scenario.name: eps_dn30_uw
scenario.label: Base + the EPS -30% exit only while the position is below cost

scenario.name: stop25
scenario.label: Base + sell at a month-end close 25% below average cost

scenario.name: time12
scenario.label: Base + sell at a month-end if held 12+ months and below cost
